design_description: A rugged, high-impact design built on the Fracture template, featuring a layered camo-style composition in black, sand, and off-white. The pattern mixes sharp breaks with splatter textures, creating a chaotic, almost shattered-surface effect across the entire jersey. Dark green trims on the collar and sleeves ground the palette, while gold branding elements add a subtle premium contrast. Overall, it feels aggressive, tactical, and battle-worn, with strong visual movement from top to bottom.
